analysis_documents.stale: The project has changed. This page retains the definition previously read; reload before renaming.
analysis_documents.catalog_defaults: Node defaults and type information come from the currently loaded catalog; they are not frozen plugin versions.
analysis_documents.recovered: A matching saved document was found. This is a current observation, not the original save receipt.
analysis_documents.recovered_changed: The document exists but differs from the attempted save. Inspect its current contents before continuing.
analysis_documents.not_found: The document is absent at this read. You may make a new explicit save.
analysis_documents.uncertain: The save reply is unavailable. Read back this identity before making another save; the write will not be replayed.
analysis_documents.name: Name
analysis_documents.save_hint: Saves the visible graph, submitted parameters and selected outputs as ordinary project cells. Saving does not run nodes or copy input files.
analysis_documents.list_stale: This list is from an earlier project revision. Refresh to see current records.
analysis_documents.empty: No analysis documents on this page.
props.preset.scalar-volume.description: Preserves positive and negative values of an explicitly named point field. Components start at 0. A blank unit keeps the source unit; a new unit label does not convert values.
analysis_runs.title: Runs
analysis_runs.prepare_hint: Preparation freezes this saved definition and the file mappings. It does not evaluate the graph.
analysis_runs.auto.hint: Run and show prepares this run, starts it, waits for it, reads and verifies the result, then shows its first viewable output in the Viewer. Each step is the same as the separate buttons; the run is recorded as usual.
analysis_runs.auto.running: Running; the result is shown when it finishes…
analysis_runs.auto.stopped: Stopped the automatic steps. The run itself is unaffected; continue or cancel it with the buttons below.
analysis_runs.auto.shown_partial: Shown “{detail}”; some outputs have errors, see the result below.
analysis_runs.auto.no_payload: The run finished without an output the Viewer can show; see the result below.
analysis_runs.auto.ended: The run ended: {detail}. Nothing was shown.
analysis_runs.auto.still_running: The run has not finished, so the automatic steps stopped waiting. Use “Read run status” later, then read the result.
analysis_runs.auto.abandoned: The project, the analysis definition or the selected run changed, so the automatic steps stopped. A started run stays in the run history.
analysis_runs.auto.uncertain: Whether the last step completed is unknown, so the automatic steps stopped; check the run identity first.
analysis_runs.auto.failed: The automatic steps did not finish: {detail}
analysis_runs.auto.viewer_failed: The result was read but could not be shown in the Viewer: {detail}
analysis_runs.upgrade: Analysis runs require project format 9. Use Project → Back up and upgrade; opening the project does not upgrade it.
analysis_runs.unavailable: Open a project with analysis-run support.
analysis_runs.uncertain: The action reply could not be confirmed. Read this run identity before taking another action.
analysis_runs.select_definition: Return to Definition and load a saved analysis first.
analysis_runs.stale_definition: The project changed. Reload the saved definition before preparing a run.
analysis_runs.empty: No analysis runs have been prepared.
analysis_runs.snapshot_hint: Choose an existing input snapshot. Register and capture files in Project first; live files are not used here.
analysis_runs.mapping_invalid: Provide a binding and an unused relative filename. At most 100 files in 32 bindings are allowed.
analysis_runs.partial: Some requested outputs failed. Available outputs are preserved; this run is not fully successful.
analysis_runs.unknown_hint: The execution outcome is unknown. This identity will not run again; prepare a new run only when you intend to repeat the work.
analysis_runs.following: Reading local run status for up to 90 seconds. No work is submitted by these reads.
analysis_runs.follow_stopped: Status tracking is paused. Read status explicitly to observe the run again.
analysis_runs.recover_hint: Checks the execution lock. An abandoned run becomes unknown; this never reruns it.
analysis_runs.frozen: Technical details: frozen definition, inputs and identifiers
analysis_runs.no_payload: No selected payload output is available for the Viewer.
analysis_runs.viewer_hint: Show an explicitly selected output in an empty Viewer. Existing Viewer data and parameters are preserved.
analysis_runs.finish_input: Finish the current desktop text edit before showing an analysis result.
analysis_runs.viewer_occupied: The shared Viewer is occupied. Close its current source explicitly before showing this result.
analysis_runs.target_changed: The project or Viewer changed before the result could be shown.
analysis_runs.canvas_hint: The canvas shows the loaded saved definition. Each run keeps its own frozen graph and inputs.
analysis_runs.budget: Budget: 300 seconds including queue time. Input files and result archive each have a 256 MiB limit.
analysis_graph.catalog_unavailable: Node descriptions could not be loaded. The saved graph remains unchanged.
analysis_parameters.title: Analysis changes
analysis_parameters.hint: Edit submitted parameters, requested outputs and single-input links locally. Save changes writes them together; the canvas and validation panel still show the saved definition.
analysis_parameters.dirty: There are unsaved analysis changes. Apply or discard unfinished parameter text before saving.
analysis_parameters.stale: This draft no longer matches the current project revision or session. Its text is preserved; discard it and reload the definition before editing again.
analysis_parameters.literal_hint: Literal text: empty input is an empty string; null is the word “null”. Press Enter to finish typing, then Apply value.
analysis_parameters.json_hint: Exact JSON value. Press Enter to finish typing, then Apply value. Removing an override is separate from setting null.
analysis_parameters.run_guard: Save or discard local analysis changes before preparing a run.
analysis_runs.no_frozen_graph: Select a saved run and choose Inspect frozen graph. Restoring this view does not read a run.
analysis_runs.frozen_definition: This copied definition belongs to the identified run. Selecting another run or changing a saved analysis does not replace it.
analysis_runs.saved_draft_preserved: Your analysis changes are retained. Return to Saved analysis to continue editing.
analysis_runs.result_not_inspected: Only the frozen output selection is shown. This view does not read or verify archived results.
analysis_outputs.title: Requested output draft
analysis_outputs.hint: Choose declared outputs for a future run. Enabling an output appends it to the request order. This does not execute the graph.
analysis_outputs.empty: [] — no outputs requested. An empty selection is saved exactly; it does not mean all outputs.
analysis_outputs.limit: At most 256 outputs can be requested. Select individual outputs across pages; Select all is unavailable for this graph.
analysis_inputs.reused: Input preparation copied from a saved run. The currently loaded analysis remains the target.
analysis_inputs.metadata_only: Snapshot metadata matches the saved run. File bytes have not been checked here; Start verifies them.
analysis_inputs.copied: Inputs copied. Review the mappings in Prepare a run before explicitly preparing a new run.
analysis_inputs.not_adopted: The input metadata was not adopted. The view, target or preparation changed, or a desktop text edit is active. Clear input preparation and choose Reuse inputs again when ready.
analysis_inputs.reading: Reading the exact input snapshot metadata…
analysis_inputs.finish_text: Press Enter to finish binding or path input before adding a file.
analysis_results.title: Archived outputs
analysis_results.hint: Browse the already verified archive. Inspection does not run the graph, load additional files, or change the Viewer.
analysis_results.missing_hint: This output is absent. Its absence alone does not establish failure or a skipped node; inspect the recorded issues.
analysis_results.not_loaded: Content not loaded: only stored metadata is shown here.
analysis_results.metadata: Dataset descriptor metadata; field data is not loaded here.
analysis_table_grid.hint: Select a row and a visible column to inspect an exact cell. Source order is preserved; row and column indices start at 0.
analysis_table_grid.name: Exact column name
analysis_table_grid.unit_missing: Unit is absent from the archived metadata.
analysis_table_grid.choose_row: Select a row to inspect its cell in this column.
analysis_table_grid.jump_hint: Enter zero-based decimal row and column indices. Press Enter to finish typing, then Go to cell.
analysis_table_grid.jump_invalid: Enter valid row and column indices within this table. Use decimal digits only; the current page and selection are unchanged.

workspace.title: Home
workspace.intro: Follow the steps from a project to results. Each button only opens the page; nothing runs until you start it there.
workspace.selection_busy: Save or reload the unsaved cell value or table/field name before switching to Files. Check other tabs and windows too.
editor.skills.title: Skills
skills.title: Skill catalog
skills.intro: Versioned built-in skills (experimental stk.skill/1). Browsing only reads definitions: it never runs a skill, prepares a run, changes a project or calls a model.
skills.unsupported: This Python service does not provide the skill catalog. Update the STK Python package and restart the service.
skills.query: Search id, title, summary or preset
skills.select: Select a skill to see its contract.
skills.unavailable_outputs: Outputs that cannot be delivered here: {outputs}
skills.run_hint: The catalog does not run this entry. Run it explicitly from the Viewer, a saved analysis or Python.
skills.guide: Method guide for models: SKILL.md pack {pack}
analysis_links.title: Links
analysis_links.hint: Reconnect a known single input to an existing upstream output, or disconnect an optional input. Validate the complete candidate before saving; nothing runs.
analysis_links.canvas_note: The canvas shows the unsaved candidate; changed nodes are outlined.
analysis_links.select_node: Select a node on the canvas or in the Node panel to edit its inputs.
analysis_links.readonly_unknown_type: Read-only: the node type is not in the catalog.
analysis_links.readonly_duplicate: Read-only: the node id is not unique.
analysis_links.readonly_undeclared: Read-only: the node type does not declare this input.
analysis_links.readonly_multi: Read-only: this list has aliased or extended entries.
analysis_links.readonly_shape: Read-only: the saved link has an alias or other keys.
analysis_links.validate_first: Saving graph changes needs a passing validation of this exact candidate.
analysis_links.valid: The candidate passed static validation. Data kinds that cannot be known in advance are still checked against the actual data at run time.
analysis_links.invalid: The candidate is invalid; resolve the issues below before saving.
analysis_links.catalog_loading: Reading the node catalog; inputs become editable once it arrives…
analysis_links.catalog_needed: Inputs stay read-only without the node catalog.
workspace.status.no_project: No project is open yet. Create one in a folder or open an existing one.
workspace.status.no_runtime: Not connected. Simulations run on a Linux STK Runtime (this machine or a server over SSH); local analyses need no server.
workspace.status.run: Prepare and follow simulations, or run saved analyses on this machine.
workspace.status.result_shown: A result is shown in the Viewer.
workspace.status.no_result: No result is shown yet. Open a finished run or a saved analysis.
workspace.service.not_started: The background service is not running; projects and runs are unavailable until it starts.
workspace.service.failed: The background service could not start: {error}. See the Service log tab for details.
path.browse_failed: The file dialog could not open ({error}); type the path instead.
project.csv.source_dialog: Choose a CSV or TSV file
project.review.json: Advanced: edit the commands as JSON
workspace.demo.tip: Makes a new project under ~/STK Projects with synthetic data: a parameter scan, solver outputs, a results table and one finished analysis run. Contacts no server or model.
project.demo.creating: Creating the example project (synthetic data, about 10 seconds)…
project.demo.created: Created and opened the example project: {path}
analysis_graph.candidate_caption: Unsaved candidate · {nodes} nodes · {edges} links (changed nodes outlined)
analysis_graph_edit.title: Edit graph structure
analysis_graph_edit.hint: Add nodes from the catalog, remove the selected node or expose its outputs. On the canvas, drag a node to move it, drag from an output socket to an input to link, and press Delete to remove the selected node. The canvas shows the unsaved candidate; validate it before saving. Nothing runs.
analysis_graph_edit.select_node: Select a node on the canvas or in the Node panel to remove it or expose its outputs.
analysis_node_params.title: Params of {node}
analysis_node_params.hint: Each change sets the node param in the unsaved candidate; empty fields use the catalog default. Params bound to analysis parameters are edited under Graph parameters.
analysis_node_params.unknown_type: This node type is not in the catalog, so its params cannot be edited here.
analysis_node_params.undeclared: not declared by the node type
analysis_graph_edit.cannot_link: This input cannot take a link here (unknown, undeclared or duplicated).
editor.workflow.title: Workflow
app.tabs.full: This area has no room for another tab; close one first.
app.navigate.refused: That object cannot be opened here.
analysis_graph.navigate_unsaved: The analysis graph has unsaved changes to another analysis; save or discard them first.
analysis_graph.breadcrumb_back.tip: Back to the workflow this analysis was opened from.
workflow.no_project: Open a project on Home first.
workflow.unsupported: The Python service or this project's format does not support workflows (format 3 or later is needed).
workflow.choose: Choose a workflow in the list on the right.
workflow.caption: {name} · {steps} steps
workflow.navigation: Drag with the right or middle button to pan, scroll to zoom, press Home to fit; click a step for its details.
workflow.intro: A workflow links parameter tables, input files, simulations and saved analyses into one process. Here you check and edit its references, links and parameter bindings and save explicitly (undoable); nothing runs, and per-row runs come later.
workflow.empty: This project has no workflows yet. The example project includes “Temperature scan”.
workflow.valid: All references and links are valid.
workflow.pick_step: Select a step on the canvas or in the problem list.
workflow.enter_analysis.tip: Open this saved analysis in the analysis graph of this area; its header leads back to the workflow.
workflow.issue.ambiguous_step: Link to a duplicated step id
workflow.issue.template_table: Rows not from the template's case table
workflow.issue.dynamic_binding: Analysis input name comes from a parameter
workflow.issue.field_not_in_workflow: Field not in this workflow's parameter tables
workflow.issue.parameter_type: Field type does not fit the parameter
workflow.navigation_edit: Drag a step to move it; drag from an output to an input to link, or onto (after) to order steps; Delete removes the selected step; right or middle drag pans, scroll zooms, Home fits.
workflow.navigate_unsaved: The workflow has unsaved changes; save or discard them first.
workflow.uncertain: The last save got no reply; reload to check before saving again.
workflow.edit.title: Edit workflow
workflow.edit.detached: This workflow changed elsewhere and the local edits are based on an older version, so they cannot be saved; discard them to see the current one.
workflow.edit.candidate_issues: {count} problems after the changes (see Problems); saving is still possible.
workflow.edit.candidate_valid: After the changes all references and links are valid.
workflow.edit.delete.tip: Deleting is an ordinary project edit; project undo restores it.
workflow.edit.deleted: Workflow deleted; project undo restores it.
workflow.edit.no_objects: The project has none of these
workflow.edit.label: Step label (optional)
workflow.edit.add_after: Add a step to wait for…
workflow.edit.no_fields: The workflow has no parameter table step to take fields from.
workflow.edit.bad_json: A fixed value is JSON, for example 1.5, "text" or [0, 1].
workflow.edit.finish_text: Finish the text edit before saving or editing further.
workflow.edit.rereading: Reading the workflow again; editing and saving resume when done, and the changes are kept.
